column1: # dr_panel_coverage_summary.tsv - per-gene ChEMBL pharmacology coverage (DR 43-gene panel)

#   - n_activities_raw: the ChEMBL API's raw total_count for target_chembl_id + standard_type__in=IC50,EC50,Ki,Kd + standard_units=nM - i.e. everything ChEMBL holds for this target under that type/unit filter.

#   - n_activities_filtered: the subset of n_activities_raw that survives the additional standard_value-not-null and data_validity_comment-null filter - this is what was actually written to chembl_panel_bioactivities.csv and what every downstream number (including this file's own n_distinct_compounds and max_pchembl) is computed from.
#   - n_distinct_compounds: number of distinct ChEMBL molecules with a qualifying (filtered) activity against this gene's target, AT ANY POTENCY.
#   - n_distinct_compounds_pchembl_ge6: the same count gated to pchembl_value >= 6 (<= 1 uM), the conventional 'active' cut.
#   - max_pchembl: the single highest pchembl_value observed for this gene.
#   - in_original_27_panel: whether this gene was part of the original CTD-based 27-gene panel (yes/no).

#   - An empty chembl_target_id or zero n_activities_filtered means this gene's pharmacology has not been resolved or measured in ChEMBL - it is a real finding, not an error, and does not mean the gene is not druggable.

#   - n_activities_raw > 0 with n_activities_filtered == 0 does NOT mean ChEMBL has no data for this gene - it means every raw record was flagged invalid or had no usable value (e.g. ACADM: 1 raw record, a 185,710 nM Kd flagged 'Outside typical range', correctly dropped).
#   - An UNGATED n_distinct_compounds can be driven entirely by weak (>100 uM) binders - use n_distinct_compounds_pchembl_ge6 for potency-aware coverage.
# SOURCE: ChEMBL REST API (https://www.ebi.ac.uk/chembl/api/data), live pull.
# WARNING: absence of a ChEMBL activity for a gene/compound pair means "not measured in ChEMBL", NOT "no interaction".
